name: 小红书 · 采集达人笔记
description: 采集小红书博主主页的笔记列表 + 博主资料:直接读页面 __INITIAL_STATE__(user.notes 首屏笔记 + userPageData 博主资料),不依赖拦 user_posted XHR(博主页首屏笔记是 SSR 注入,不发翻页接口)。字段见 docs/extraction/XIAOHONGSHU.md。

variables.label: 采集笔记数量上限（默认 100;滚动加载到该数或博主笔记采完为止）

steps.description: 导航到博主主页(就地采集时当前标签已在该页,会重载一次以确保 __INITIAL_STATE__ 注入)
校验已登录。selector/文案待真机校准

params.errorMessage: 当前小红书未登录,请先登录后再重试

steps.description: 校验未触发风控验证。selector/文案待真机校准

failWhen.value: 当前访问环境存在异常

params.errorMessage: 当前小红书触发风控验证,请先完成验证后再重试

steps.description: 等首屏笔记 + 博主资料注入 __INITIAL_STATE__
主动滚动加载更多笔记进 user.notes,直到够 limitNotes 或滚到底(数量连续不增)

params.countExpr: (function(){try{var S=window.__INITIAL_STATE__;if(!S)return 0;var u=function(x){var h=0;while(x&&typeof x==='object'&&'_rawValue' in x&&h<8){x=x._rawValue;h++;}return x;};var g=u(u(S.user).notes);var n=0;if(Array.isArray(g))for(var i=0;i<g.length;i++){var l=u(g[i]);if(Array.isArray(l))n+=l.length;}return n;}catch(e){return 0;}})()

steps.description: 读 __INITIAL_STATE__.user.notes(二维分组,每项 noteCard)提取笔记列表

params.fn: (function(){var S=window.__INITIAL_STATE__;if(!S||typeof S!=='object')return [];var unref=function(x){var h=0;while(x&&typeof x==='object'&&'_rawValue' in x&&h<8){x=x._rawValue;h++;}return x;};var str=function(v){v=unref(v);return typeof v==='string'?v:'';};var arr=function(v){v=unref(v);return Array.isArray(v)?v:[];};var norm=function(v){v=str(v);return v.indexOf('http://')===0?'https://'+v.slice(7):v;};var groups=arr((unref(S.user)||{}).notes);var out=[];var seen={};for(var g=0;g<groups.length;g++){var list=arr(groups[g]);for(var i=0;i<list.length;i++){var item=unref(list[i]);if(!item||typeof item!=='object')continue;var card=unref(item.noteCard);if(!card)continue;var nid=str(card.noteId)||str(item.id);if(!nid||seen[nid])continue;seen[nid]=1;var ic=unref(card.interactInfo)||{};var cv=unref(card.cover)||{};var usr=unref(card.user)||{};out.push({note_id:nid,note_url:'https://www.xiaohongshu.com/explore/'+nid,title:str(card.displayTitle),type:str(card.type),cover:norm(cv.urlDefault||cv.url||cv.urlPre),liked_count:str(ic.likedCount),author_name:str(usr.nickname||usr.nickName),author_id:str(usr.userId)});}}return out;})

steps.description: 读 __INITIAL_STATE__.user.userPageData 提取博主资料(单行)

params.fn: (function(){var S=window.__INITIAL_STATE__;if(!S||typeof S!=='object')return [];var unref=function(x){var h=0;while(x&&typeof x==='object'&&'_rawValue' in x&&h<6){x=x._rawValue;h++;}return x;};var str=function(v){v=unref(v);return typeof v==='string'?v:'';};var arr=function(v){v=unref(v);return Array.isArray(v)?v:[];};var norm=function(v){v=str(v);return v.indexOf('http://')===0?'https://'+v.slice(7):v;};var up=unref((unref(S.user)||{}).userPageData)||{};var basic=unref(up.basicInfo)||{};var inter=arr(up.interactions);var pick=function(t){for(var i=0;i<inter.length;i++){var it=unref(inter[i]);if(it&&it.type===t)return str(it.count);}return '';};var loc=location.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean);var uid=(loc[0]==='user'&&loc[1]==='profile')?loc[2]:'';var nick=str(basic.nickname||basic.nickName);if(!uid&&!nick)return [];var g=unref(basic.gender);return [{user_id:uid,avatar:norm(basic.images),red_id:str(basic.redId),nickname:nick,desc:str(basic.desc),gender:(typeof g==='number'?(g===1?'女':(g===2?'男':'')):str(g)),ip_location:str(basic.ipLocation),fans:pick('fans'),follows:pick('follows'),interaction:pick('interaction')}];})
